<span class="chem-kicker">LECTURE INDEX · EXAM I FOUNDATION</span>

# Chapters 1–6

The supplied slide decks contain **452 slides** across six chapters. This index records their conceptual scope without redistributing copyrighted slide content. The Fall 2026 syllabus assigns **Chapters 2–6** to Exam I; Chapter 1 remains a course foundation.

::: {.chem-chapter-grid}
::: {.chem-chapter-card .foundation}
<span>CH 01 · 58 SLIDES</span>
### Biochemistry and the unity of life
Chemical foundations, cellular organization, evolution, energy, and the molecular logic of living systems.
:::
::: {.chem-chapter-card}
<span>CH 02 · 105 SLIDES</span>
### Protein composition and architecture
Amino acids, peptide bonds, secondary structure, folding, domains, quaternary structure, and protein modification.
:::
::: {.chem-chapter-card}
<span>CH 03 · 92 SLIDES</span>
### Exploring proteins and proteomes
Purification, chromatography, electrophoresis, antibodies, mass spectrometry, sequencing, X-ray crystallography, and NMR.
:::
::: {.chem-chapter-card}
<span>CH 04 · 81 SLIDES</span>
### DNA, RNA, and the flow of information
Nucleic-acid structure, replication, transcription, RNA processing, translation, and the genetic code.
:::
::: {.chem-chapter-card}
<span>CH 05 · 71 SLIDES</span>
### Genes and genomes
Restriction enzymes, sequencing, PCR, cloning, expression analysis, genome editing, transgenic models, and gene therapy.
:::
::: {.chem-chapter-card}
<span>CH 06 · 45 SLIDES</span>
### Evolution and bioinformatics
Homology, sequence alignment, substitution matrices, BLAST, structural conservation, phylogeny, and horizontal gene transfer.
:::
:::

::: {.chem-source-note}
### Materials and rights
Chapter descriptions were independently summarized from the supplied lecture decks. The decks identify *Biochemistry*, 8th edition (Macmillan Education, 2015) and John Tymoczko in their metadata. The course syllabus lists the 9th-edition textbook. Slide files and publisher artwork are not reproduced or offered for download here.
